snippet.title: The Patient: Can You Escape? | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into a mysterious German sanatorium in the 1930s in The Patient - can you escape?, a first-person escape game with subtle horror elements. Explore its dark corridors, search for useful items, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within the sanatorium. But stay alert... you are not alone.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285430/The_Patient__can_you_escape/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
